name: io.github.warmcoding/sonicaura-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for audio stem separation, denoise, and reverb.

tools.name: list_audio_tools
tools.description: List available audio processing task types and their metadata.

tools.name: check_service_status
tools.description: Check if the audio service is available and confirm remaining credits.

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Get a presigned URL to upload an audio file larger than 1 MB.

tools.name: upload_audio
tools.description: Upload a small audio file (under 1 MB) via base64 encoding.

tools.name: process_audio
tools.description: Submit an audio task. task_type: music_denoise | denoise | reverb | 2stems | 4stems | 6stems.

tools.name: check_task_status
tools.description: Poll the status of a task started by process_audio.

tools.name: get_my_credits
tools.description: Check the current user's remaining credits.
